grovefs-client prebuilt clients
built: 2026-11-26
host: Linux 5.4.0-216-generic x86_64
rustc: rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28)
cargo: cargo 1.99.0 (5f94df478 2026-08-27)
source: grovefs-client bb76a9f (feat(client) commit; the two binaries,
        SHA256SUMS.txt and this file are the release artifacts in this drop)
        against sibling grovefs kernel at 87fc57e (master; the audit of
        f435975..87fc57e - 27 kernel commits - touched nothing on the
        client-shared surface: src/remote/**, fs_impl, layout, manager,
        and the M_OPEN ack region is byte-for-byte unchanged, so there
        was no protocol adaptation due in this drop)
profile: release, lto=true, stripped
grovefs-mac: Linux build, fuser pure-Rust mount (macOS build needs macFUSE 4.x)
grovefs-win: Linux build, cfg(not(windows)) stub, no WinFsp FFI
what changed vs the previous drop (a1f6edc @ kernel f435975):
  * GROVEFS_API_KEY env fallback in BOTH shells: with --api-key left empty
    the credential is read from the environment, the same entry shape as
    `grovefs mount`, so a deployment can keep the secret out of ps and
    shell history. argv still wins when the flag is given.
  * grovefs-mac --layout FILE: the presentation lens (grovefs::layout::
    LayoutMeta, the same rules file and semantics as the kernel mount's
    --layout) now wraps the remote meta chain for THIS mount only -
    hide/only/map/link reshape only what this client sees, writes through
    the lens land on the real entries, the stored tree and every other
    mount are untouched. The mount banner reports the parsed rule counts.
    grovefs-win deliberately does NOT carry --layout yet: WinFsp breaks
    names as \path\to\name, the lens path space differs, and no claim is
    made without real-machine verification.
regression: `cargo test --workspace` from this source tree: grovefs-mac
        9 tests and grovefs-win 19 tests (11 mapping + 7 roster/bootstrap
        + 1 env-key precedence); the env fallback is asserted argv-wins,
        and --layout is pinned as an optional path flag. Release help
        (`--help` lists --layout and names the env fallback) and
        `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt` were also checked for this drop.
negative control (per binary CONTENT, not path/timestamp): the previous
        drop's binaries carry neither "GROVEFS_API_KEY" nor "--layout";
        this drop's grovefs-mac carries the "layout overlay" banner. A
        cross-version check must grep these strings before trusting which
        generation a binary belongs to.
e2e: scratch stage /data/grovefs/.tmpedit/client_iter_20261126.sh against
        a live manager+pair cluster: 23/23 - roster bootstrap read/write,
        env RW key admitted by a --require-api-key pair (the gate is REAL:
        mounting the same key at an ungated deployment is asserted to be
        ignored), --layout hide/map, lens write lands on the real path
        (kernel mount sees it), no-lens read-back, env RO key arrives as
        ack byte [0] -> whole mount read-only, server-side EROFS keeps
        the mount alive (refusal verified via kernel mount too).
